meta.title: Approving after you already rejected bounces back
gaps: Create and submit the event into a two-step approval workflow.
Open Asha's mailbox and the Procol approval email.
Reject the request with the required comment and send the rejection email.
Wait for Procol to process the mailbox email.
Approve the already-rejected request from the original email and send it.
Verify the bounce-back message and that the event remains rejected.
